zh:
康奈尔大学（Cornell University）成立于1865年，位于美国纽约州伊萨卡市，是常春藤盟校成员之一，也是美国学科设置最全面的综合性私立研究型大学。学校下设14个学院，在校生超27000人，覆盖农业、工程、酒店管理、兽医学、建筑、文理、法学、医学等全领域。
康奈尔大学以“任何人都能在任何学科中获得教育”为办学理念，是常春藤盟校中首个实行男女同校的大学，培养了47位诺贝尔奖得主、4位菲尔兹奖得主、1位图灵奖得主。学校的酒店管理学院、农业与生命科学学院、工程学院均处于世界顶尖水平。2026QS世界大学排名中，康奈尔大学位列世界第16位。
en: Cornell University is a private research university in Ithaca, New York, United States. Founded in 1865, Cornell is a member of the Ivy League and the most academically comprehensive university in the United States. The University comprises 14 colleges, with over 27,000 enrolled students, covering agriculture, engineering, hotel management, veterinary medicine, architecture, arts and sciences, law, and medicine. Cornell was the first Ivy League university to become coeducational, with the mission of 'I would found an institution where any person can find instruction in any study'. It has produced 47 Nobel Prize winners, 4 Fields Medalists, and 1 Turing Award winner. Ranked No.16 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
